propositions: Plan-review relationship health (pin drift, enforcement posture, phase compatibility) must be exposed in detailed CLI show, MCP ticket detail, audit output, close errors, and web review UI without modifying list output or persisted events.

DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract must be consumed consistently by all detailed renderers without independent status-string definitions, displaying canonical related tickets, normalized roles, fingerprint status, missing-target state, and enforcement effects.
Pin enforcement disabled state must be labeled as advisory drift, legacy-unpinned must be distinguishable from current-no-relationships, and enforcement-off validity must remain truthful.

Audit rendering must call compute_validity at the build_context/page assembly boundary after audit_trail completes, with errors caught, logged, and rendered as unavailable-health without changing audit_trail behavior or validity-gate semantics.
Advanced plan-review/attestation documentation must cover plan-material-pin, phase metadata, rollout behavior, deletion repair, and validity profiles; basic user docs remain unchanged.
